title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Evidence Misgrounding in Multimodal Knowledge Editing
abstract: arXiv:2610.33075v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal knowledge editing aims to update visually grounded facts in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) while preserving unrelated text and visual behaviors. However, standard answer-level metrics can hide evidence misgrounding: an edit may produce the target answer on the original image yet remain sensitive to incidental context rather than the intended visual evidence. To examine this issue in a controlled setting, we construct WaterBird-Edit, an analysis set that decouples bird habitat labels from background context and measures whether edited predictions remain stable when the target evidence is preserved but the background changes. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose VICE (Visual In-Context Editing), a retrieval-based framework that stores edits in external memory and applies them through visual in-context demonstrations designed to expose task-relevant evidence. translated_title: 多模态知识编辑中证据误锚定问题的诊断与缓解
translated_abstract: 多模态知识编辑旨在更新多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中基于视觉的事实，同时保持无关的文本和视觉行为不受影响。然而，标准的答案级指标可能掩盖“证据误锚定”问题：一次编辑可能在原始图像上产生目标答案，但其仍然对偶然的背景上下文敏感，而非依赖于预期的视觉证据。为了在受控环境中考察这一问题，我们构建了WaterBird-Edit分析集，该数据集将鸟类栖息地标签与背景上下文解耦，并测量当目标证据被保留而背景发生变化时，编辑后的预测是否保持稳定。基于这一诊断结果，我们提出了VICE（Visual In-Context Editing，视觉上下文编辑），一个基于检索的框架，它将编辑存储在外部记忆中，并通过旨在凸显任务相关证据的视觉上下文示例来应用这些编辑。在三个标准基准上的实验表明，VICE
tldr: 本文发现多模态知识编辑中存在答案正确但证据误锚定的问题，构建了WaterBird-Edit诊断数据集，并提出基于检索与视觉上下文示例的VICE框架来缓解该问题。
en_tdlr: This paper diagnoses evidence misgrounding in multimodal knowledge editing, introduces the WaterBird-Edit benchmark, and proposes VICE, a retrieval-based framework applying edits via visual in-context demonstrations to ensure edits rely on intended visual evidence.
